label: thm:intro-main
title: Potts zero-freeness near [0,1]
note: At 6q = 11Δ, where the paper cites CFFGZZ Theorem 20 for the x = 0 coupling bound, Lean proves it by the Carlson–Vigoda contraction. The introduction's FPTAS for Z_G(q; x) and effective choice of ε are not formalized.

label: thm:potts-transfer
title: Coupling independence implies zero-freeness
note: Lean classes are closed under relabelled induced subgraphs. The coupling bounds are required only when both child laws exist, which q ≥ Δ+1 guarantees. Lean does not need Δ ≥ 2.

label: lem:hard-feas
title: Hard feasibility
note: Lean states both claims for residual instances whose free degree plus pinned-neighbour count is at most Δ at every vertex. For G ∈ 𝒢_Δ, the residual instance of τ is one, and its partition function at 0 is Ẑ^τ_G(0).

label: def:potts-ci
title: Potts coupling independence
note: Lean defines the bound at one activity x, and only for classes closed under induced subgraphs; coupling independence on J is the bound at every x ∈ J. It is required only when both child partitions are positive, which holds for q ≥ Δ+1.

label: lem:cavg
title: Complex averages under nearby laws
note: Lean bounds an explicit logarithm, centeredAverageLogRatio, for any anchor point. It is continuous along the path t(h, η, η'), t ∈ [0, 1], and zero at t = 0, so by uniqueness of continuous logarithms it is the paper's branch. The cost d need not be a metric.

label: lem:potts-hard-comparison
title: One-vertex comparison at z=0
note: The values at z = 0 are real; Lean compares their real parts.

label: lem:finite-endpoint-closure
title: Finite-state continuity of normalized laws
note: Lean needs the weights nonnegative only near 0 and right-continuous at 0, allows any nonnegative cost d with d(a,a) = 0 and the triangle inequality, and takes the liminf in the extended reals.

label: lem:active-rep
title: Soft Potts as a random hard-colouring model
note: Stated in joint-weight form: Lean conditions J(A,σ) on an active set A of positive mass. That sampling σ ∼ μ and then A has joint law J(A,σ)/Z is a definitional unfolding.

label: def:flip
title: Hard list-flip transition
note: The swapped set is the alternating {X_u, c}-component of u, which equals the paper's induced component on proper colourings.

label: lem:coupled-activation-root-local
title: The two hard instances differ only near v
note: Lean adds that both colourings are proper for their instances and that the two active sets form a coupling of the activation laws supported on root-local pairs.

label: lem:boundary-sensitivity
title: Effect of adding one labelled free–pinned edge

label: prop:hard-one-step
title: Conditional hard estimate
note: Stated for every coin outcome, with no degree bound, as a bound on W_Ham between the two hard steps; a coupling meeting the bound is constructed in Lean.

label: prop:full-interval-hci
title: Vigoda-profile coupling for newly pinned laws
note: The bound for x ∈ (0,1] does not need Δ ≥ 2. The claim at x = 0 is the case x = 0 of root_strict_ci, which covers all x ∈ [0,1].

label: cor:critical-line-input
title: Coupling input at q=11Delta/6
note: The x = 0 bound is proved by extending the Carlson–Vigoda contraction, not from CFFGZZ Theorem 20 as in the paper's proof.

label: prop:field-transfer
title: Field transfer
note: θ is quantified before the class 𝒢, so it depends only on (q, Δ, C₀).

label: thm:lee-yang
title: Lee–Yang polydisc
note: Regimes (i) and (ii) use the closed polydisc |λ_{u,c} − 1| ≤ θ, which is stronger.

label: rem:lee-yang-related
title: Related results
note: Compares Theorem 5.2 with cited results.

label: cor:edge-lee-yang
title: Edge-colour Lee–Yang polydisc
note: The polydisc is closed, |λ_{e,c} − 1| ≤ θ, which is stronger. For the full polynomial, Lean needs only λ_{e,τ_e} ≠ 0 on pinned edges, and proves it is nonzero exactly when τ is proper.

label: lem:holant-residual-input
title: Residual Holant input
note: Each clause is a separate declaration. Lean allows any Δ, R ≥ 0 and parallel edges, gives C = 2((1 + A²R)^Δ − 1) with A the largest g(1) over 𝓕_res, and gets the properties of 𝓕_res from its definition.

label: thm:holant-box
title: Log-concave Holant polytube
note: Lean allows any Δ and any R ≥ 0. The diagonal claim is stated for some open U ⊇ [0, ∞) chosen before the graph and the signatures.

label: cor:bmatching-short
title: b-matchings
note: Lean does not need Δ ≥ 2.

label: rem:matching-degree-dependence
title: Dependence on the maximum degree
note: The Heilmann–Lieb and Wagner sentences are cited background and are not formalized.

label: cor:bcover-short
title: b-edge covers
note: The width is one function ε of λ₋ = a, chosen before λ₊ = c, the graph and b. Lean does not need Δ ≥ 2, and also states the diagonal remark that follows the corollary.

label: rem:additional-potts-transfer
title: Transfer and the hard endpoint
note: Lean proves the girth rows by transferring on residual instances directly; zero_free_of_girth_class formalizes the leaf-realization route described here. The unnormalized conclusions are stated in each row's zero-free theorem.

label: lem:pinned-leaf-realization
title: Pinned-leaf realization
note: Lean also gives an isomorphism of the free graphs that keeps each free vertex's degree in G. Girth is compared both as extended girth (⊤ for forests, the paper's convention) and as mathlib's ℕ-valued girth.

label: lem:hard-feas
title: Hard feasibility
note: Both are stated for any boundary-count instance I with I.DegreeBound Δ. The paper's case is I = (G^τ, b^τ), where a degree bound Δ on G gives I.DegreeBound Δ.

label: def:potts-ci
title: Potts coupling independence
note: Lean states the bound at one activity x; coupling independence on J is the bound at every x ∈ J. It is required only when both child partition functions are positive, which holds for q ≥ Δ+1.

label: thm:potts-transfer
title: Potts transfer
note: Classes are closed under relabelled induced subgraphs, and the coupling inputs are required only when both child laws exist. Lean does not need Δ ≥ 2 and also gives the multiplicity m_G(τ) of the zero at 0.

label: lem:potts-positive-response
title: Positive-base Potts induction
note: Lean assumes q ≥ 1, which the paper leaves implicit.

label: prop:full-interval-hci
title: Vigoda-profile coupling for newly pinned laws
note: Lean does not need Δ ≥ 2 for x ∈ (0, 1]. The x = 0 claim is root_strict_ci, stated for every x ∈ [0, 1] when q > 11Δ/6.

label: cor:critical-line-input
title: Critical-line coupling input
note: The x = 0 bound is proved by extending the Carlson–Vigoda contraction, not from CFFGZZ Theorem 20 as in the paper's proof.

label: lem:soft-stationary
title: Soft flip kernels
note: Stated for any boundary-count instance I, which covers every (G, τ).

label: lem:coupled-activation-root-local
title: The two hard instances differ only near v
note: Stated for every x ∈ (0, 1] on a boundary-count instance I, including x = 1, where no constraint is activated. Lean also packages the common coins as a coupling of the two activation laws.

label: lem:boundary-sensitivity
title: Effect of adding one labelled free–pinned edge
note: The companion now says ‘k labelled free–pinned edges’, as in the main text, in place of ‘k labelled constraints’.

label: lem:finite-endpoint-closure
title: Finite-state continuity of normalized laws
note: Lean needs the weights nonnegative only near 0 and right-continuous at 0, and allows any cost d that is nonnegative, zero on the diagonal and satisfies the triangle inequality. The last clause, W_d ≤ liminf_{x↓0} B(x), is the extension to x = 0.

title: Literature and algorithmic use of the three [0,1] regimes
note: Literature attribution for the three regimes.

label: rem:critical-scope
title: The hard endpoint on the critical line
note: That CFFGZZ Theorem 20 and Proposition 22 apply, a claim about the cited papers, is not formalized; Lean proves the same x = 0 bound by the Carlson–Vigoda contraction. The list slack and the uniform law at x = 0 are proved too.

label: thm:potts-ci-regimes
title: Coupling inputs in the three additional Potts regimes
note: The three regimes are stated on root-conditioned residual instances; relabelling gives every (G, τ, r) of 𝒢. In regime (i) one constant serves all of [0, 1], the critical pairs included, which the paper does not assert.

label: thm:intro-bbr-interval
title: A BBR-certified interval at large girth

label: cor:intro-high-temperature
title: General-graph high-temperature intervals
note: Lean needs neither Δ ≥ 2 nor x_* ≤ 1.

label: thm:unrestricted-girth5
title: Unrestricted girth-five zero-freeness
note: The existential threshold Δ₅(δ) is fixed as girthFiveCIThreshold δ, shared with the girth-five coupling theorem.

title: Scope and relation to the spectral-gap input
note: Attributes the ingredients; the gap itself is Theorem 9.7.

label: thm:cv-ci
title: Hamming coupling independence at 1.809 Δ
note: Stated for residual instances on Option O with root none; the (G, τ, r) form follows by relabelling V^τ as Option O with r ↦ none.

label: def:cv-kernel
title: Soft-CV kernel
note: Defined for every x ∈ [0,1] (at x = 1 no constraint is active); on (0,1) it is proved equal to the profile kernel K_{x,P}.

label: def:cv-metric
title: Geometric soft-CV metric
note: The coefficient identity (P₂ − P₃)/2 = 17/200 and the limit d_x → hard metric as x ↓ 0 (for q ≥ 1.809Δ) are proved; that this hard metric is [CV24, Eq. (2)] is a citation, not formalized.

label: lem:cv-metric
title: Metric comparison; adjacent geodesics
note: Lean covers x ∈ [0,1] and needs only 0 < Δ and free degrees at most Δ.

label: lem:cv-path
title: A path upper bound for the geometric metric
note: Lean covers x ∈ [0,1] and assumes, as the section does, q ≥ 1.809Δ, 0 < Δ and free degrees at most Δ.

label: lem:cv-root-local-structure
title: Components near the disagreement vertex
note: Stated for any two hard instances related by RootLocalPair, which every coupled activation outcome satisfies.

label: lem:cv-move-partition
title: Partition of the aggregate moves
note: Stated for any pair related by RootLocalPair. Moves are identified with their outputs; a move remains when it has positive residual mass after the synchronous coupling.

label: def:cv-component-matching
title: Conditional coupling matrix
note: Built for any choice of one root neighbour per colour and side (GlobalChoice), the paper's largest-component choice included. The claims inside the definition (full singleton matching, no overfilling, the one-unit saving, root-colour capacities) are proved.

label: lem:cv-completion
title: Component matching and product completion
note: Lean indexes the matrix by output configurations; distinct feasible moves have distinct outputs, so this matches the paper's indexing by moves.

label: lem:cv-completion-cost
title: Cost of the completed coupling
note: The completion bound is proved for any cost d with d(U,Z) ≤ a(U) + b(Z); it applies to d = hamDrift with the move sizes a = Ham(X,·), b = Ham(Y,·). The last claim is Lemma 5.7.

label: lem:cv-component-budgets
title: Conditional component budgets
note: Part 1 is proved for any set of regular colours with k_c ≤ 2, which covers 𝒞_low. The last assertion is stated as: the root's own score plus all cross credits is at most 𝒮_out.

label: lem:cv-fresh
title: Fresh-colour gain
note: Lean also proves the bound for every activation outcome, before averaging.

label: lem:cv-incidence
title: Ordered-incidence discount bound
note: Lean writes the contribution as θs_u times the root-kept mass disturbing w, minus θx^{t_w} times the same-neighbour entry, averaged over the coins; w need not be adjacent to u.

label: lem:cv-expected
title: Expected loss of the geometric discount
note: Lean's Loss_u is the first-cause charge, an upper bound on the paper's.

label: def:cv-component-records
title: Finite component records
note: The claims made inside the definition are proved in Lean.

label: lem:cv-balancing-domination
title: Balancing-point domination
note: The closing facts that each term of the maximum equals 226/125 at the balancing pair and that the pair lies in R_γ are closed rational arithmetic with no separate declaration.

label: lem:cv-special
title: The two root colours
note: Lean states the bound for the colour a; the colour b follows by swapping the two sides.

label: thm:cv-contraction
title: Geometric soft-CV contraction
note: Lean constructs the coupling explicitly, for every x ∈ (0,1].

label: lem:cv-child-middle
title: Soft-CV child–middle row discrepancy
note: Includes x = 1.

label: thm:high-girth-soft-ci
title: Large-girth coupling independence
note: Stated on residual instances with a distinguished free root; the (G, τ, r) form follows by relabelling the free vertices so that r becomes the root.

label: lem:hg-jacobian-factor
title: Exact Jacobian factorization
note: The squared operator-norm bound is stated as the energy inequality Σ_c (J^p_v h)_c² ≤ F₁F₂‖h‖², assuming every p_v(c) > 0 (true for x > 0). J^p_v is given by its explicit entries, which Lean proves are the derivative of the φ-transformed recursion.

label: lem:hg-continuous-marginal
title: Pointwise marginal bound
note: The marginal bounds are stated for any weights a ∈ [0,1]^q and any A ≤ Σ_c a(c) with d + 4 ≤ A; the paper's A̲_v qualifies by Bernoulli's inequality and the four units of slack.

label: lem:hg-continuous-amortized
title: Occupancy-factor bound
note: LocalRecursion allows any palette bound A ≤ Σ_c a_v(c) with d_v + 4 ≤ A in place of A̲_v, and likewise for each child; the paper's choice qualifies.

label: lem:hg-strong-jacobian
title: Weighted Jacobian contraction
note: Stated in squared form: with T = max_i w_i²‖h_i‖², it reads w_v²‖Ĵ_v h‖² ≤ ρ²T, the weighted-norm bound. The weight range is stated as 1 ≤ w_v² ≤ e^{1/6} on cavity trees.

label: lem:hg-finite-difference
title: From Jacobian contraction to message contraction
note: Stated in squared form with w² = 1/(1 − ζ) and ρ² = e^{−8/(81q)}, for inputs m_i and n_i ≤ B_i: taking T = max_i w_i²‖φ(n_i) − φ(m_i)‖² and square roots gives the displayed bound.

label: lem:hg-root-response
title: Bounded root response
note: The identity is stated entry by entry where 0 < p_r(c) < 1. The norm bound is the energy inequality for rootInfluenceAction, the right-hand side, whenever every m_{u→r}(c) ∈ [0, 1/4].

label: lem:hg-tid
title: Tree total-influence decay
note: Stated on cavity trees, which record a pinned tree by its free component and pinned-neighbour colour counts, for each pair of root colours, with ℓ = k + 1.

label: lem:hg-eventual-relative-ssm
title: Relative SSM beyond a fixed depth
note: Stated with K = k + 2 on cavity trees agreeing up to the shell. The ratio form has an existential threshold; at every K ≥ K₁ it follows from the log bound, as |log r| ≤ ε ≤ 1 gives |r − 1| ≤ 2ε.

label: lem:hg-eventual-transfer
title: Large-girth transfer from tree decay
note: The companion now states the lemma for the Potts family at positive activity, its only use, in place of general pairwise spin systems. Lean fixes g and the cost before x, so no set J appears; A = C_INFL, B = C_SM, ρ = 1 − δ.

label: lem:bbr-certificate
title: BBR contraction certificate
note: Jointly realizable pairs are cavity trees related by SameDomain; the distance-one condition is stated as equal boundary counts at u, which agreeing pins imply.

label: lem:bbr-differential
title: Differential contraction
note: The inequality is proved for every x ∈ (0, 1]. jacobianBlock is the closed-form block of the paper's proof; Lean proves separately that it is the derivative of the recursion.

label: lem:bbr-influence-factorization
title: Influence–Jacobian identity
note: Lean proves the level identity at every depth k; the per-vertex identity is its case with h supported on one vertex.

label: prop:bbr-tree-tid
title: Tree total-influence decay
note: Level k + 1 of the tree rooted at r is the sphere ℓ = k + 1, so contractionRate Δ ^ k is θ^{ℓ−1}.

label: lem:bbr-tree-ssm
title: Uniform relative SSM
note: The children agree to depth k, so the first possible disagreement is at distance K = k + 2 from r: the bounds read Δqκ^{K−2} and C_SM θ^K.

label: thm:bbr-large-girth-ci
title: BBR-certified interval at large girth
note: Stated on residual instances (free graph with boundary counts) with a distinguished root; the (G, τ, r) form follows by relabelling the free vertices of G^τ so that r is the root.

label: lem:slot-fact
title: Slot representation
note: Proved by compactness from finite real-rooted approximants instead of the paper's Hadamard-factorization argument.

label: lem:edge-slot-lift
title: Exact lift and inherited bounds
note: Slot labels are ℕ rather than r ≥ 1, so lifted states lie in C × ℕ × ℕ. Lean proves it for every slot law κ of the slot representation and every ordering of the free edges' endpoints.

label: lem:edge-one-label
title: One-label coupling bound
note: Lean bounds W_{1,F} for each comparison with |F| ≤ n in every countable slot model, which bounds the supremum T_n; T_0 = 0 is the case n = 0. α ≠ β is not required.

label: lem:girth5-disintegration
title: Second-layer disintegration
note: Here v is the vertex none of a residual instance on Option V. Every x ≥ 0 is covered.

label: lem:girth5-one-edge
title: One-edge colour operator
note: Every x ∈ [0,1], including x = 0.

label: lem:girth5-color-covariance
title: Colour covariance of the insertion residual
note: The covariance bounds are stated as Var(Σ_c z_c G_c) ≤ g_Δ²‖z‖₂²; the weighted bound follows with z_c√r_c. β_{u,c} ignores σ_{W_u} because it involves only π_{j,c} for j ≠ u, each a function of σ_{W_j}.

label: thm:girth5-ci
title: Unrestricted girth-five coupling independence
note: Stated on residual instances with degree budget Δ and root none. The (G, τ, r) form follows by relabelling V^τ as Option O, since maximum degree Δ in G gives the budget.

label: lem:girth5-star-bounds
title: Star bounds and singleton complement
note: R ≥ c_δ and the operator bounds are proved for every star with SchurParameters, which every star of a residual instance satisfies under the lemma's hypotheses. ‖P_00‖ ≤ r_* and the additive compression are stated as quadratic-form bounds.

label: lem:girth5-star-incidence
title: Unequal-incidence star inequality
note: Proved for every star with SchurParameters, which includes every star of a residual instance under the hypotheses. The operator inequality is stated through its quadratic form at every function f; d = 0 is included.

label: thm:potts-gap-girth5
title: Uniform spectral gap under the degree budget
